d:
A dungeon suddenly appeared, open only to female members… Saeko, Seonhee, and Chitose bravely took on the challenge, only to be met by jungle kings from across time and space!
Despite their inherent courage and combat abilities, they tried to fight back, but the difference in power between the two sides was undeniable! They begged to become the mating wives of these kings who could freely wield even the most extreme techniques, and never returned to their own world!
